name: Costochondritis
definition: Benign inflammatory or mechanical pain of the costochondral or chondrosternal junctions, diagnosed only after clinically important cardiac, pulmonary and other causes are considered.

typical: Pain with upper-body movement or deep breathing

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical after appropriate exclusion of serious causes.
investigations.radiographs: Chest radiography/testing depends on alternative diagnosis rather than costochondritis itself.

amber: Persistent atypical chest pain requires reassessment rather than repeated symptomatic treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Urah/Parshva-shoola phenotype may be documented only after emergency causes are excluded.

patientEducation.summary: Benign inflammatory or mechanical pain of the costochondral or chondrosternal junctions, diagnosed only after clinically important cardiac, pulmonary and other causes are considered.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
